slug: 说好武侠世界你怎么教人修仙
lines: 萧家大堂。
三人看向天空中的巨指，都是愣了片刻。
萧斩低头沉思了片刻后道：
“这么说来，仙师向来低调，极少展露手段。”
边说著，他的眉眼便是越发的上挑，喜上眉梢：。
“此次出手，想来也是为了火火！”
“倒还真有可能，是为了教火火而施展。”
余下几大长老看向天幕，震撼的同时，也流露出一副羡艷的神情，纷纷嘆息道：
“火火找了个好师尊啊！”
后院，隨著楚风的手指向下点来，天空的巨指也捲起一阵云浪向下袭来。

在厚实的灵力下方，眾人都是感到一阵压力。
簫火火则全程盯看著，激动到了极点
这等惊天动地的威势，不愧是传说中武祖用过的招式。
仅仅半指就已经到达了此种程度，若是全都学会了，那不得將天都给捅破了？
不过，还未待这等压力延伸至极致，那巨指便是突然化为气旋散了去。
簫火火的神色一愣，回头看向楚风：
却见楚风淡然的一笑：
“这是为师以链气一重境修为，打出的半指撼天地。”
簫火火木在了原地，有些失神：
“以链气境一层……”
看向自己的双手：
“以链气一层施展出这种威力？”
“链气一层，居然是能做到这种地步吗……”
他现在就是链气一层的修为，若是成功的掌握了，也不知道能不能做到师尊那一步……
旋即，簫火火紧握著双手，神色坚毅。
“师尊既然展现出来给我看，那就是说明我也一定能做到师尊的那一步。”
“一定可以。”
看著紧握双拳的簫火火，楚风暗暗一笑。
这小子肯定又在脑补了。
他嘆息一声，內心暗道：

Xiao family lobby.
The three of them looked at the giant finger in the sky and were stunned for a moment.
Xiao Zhan lowered his head and thought for a moment before saying:
"So, the Immortal Master has always kept a low profile and rarely shows off his methods."
As he spoke, his eyebrows became more and more raised, and he said with joy.
"This time I take action, I think it's for the sake of fire!"
"It's really possible that it was used to teach Huo Huo."
The remaining elders looked at the sky. While shocked, they also showed envious expressions and sighed:
"Huo Huo has found a good master!"
…
In the backyard, as Chu Feng's finger pointed downwards, the giant finger in the sky also rolled up a wave of clouds and struck downwards.

Under the thick spiritual power, everyone felt a burst of pressure.
Xiao Huohuo watched the whole process, extremely excited.
This earth-shattering power is indeed a move used by the legendary Martial Ancestor.
He has already reached this level with just half a finger. If he learned them all, how could he break the whole world?
However, before the pressure could reach its extreme, the giant finger suddenly turned into a cyclone and dispersed.
Xiao Huohuo looked stunned for a moment and turned back to look at Chu Feng:
"Master..."
But Chu Feng smiled calmly:
"This is a half-finger shot by my master who cultivated at the first level of chain energy to shake the world."
Xiaohuo Huomu was still where he was, a little absent-minded:
"With the first level of Chain Qi Realm..."
Looking at his hands:
"Using one layer of chain energy to display this kind of power?"
"Is it possible to achieve this level at the first level of Chain Qi..."
He is currently at the first level of Qi Chain. If he successfully masters it, he doesn't know if he can reach the level of Master...
Immediately, Xiao Huohuo clenched his hands with a determined expression.
"Since Master has shown it to me, it means that I will definitely be able to achieve what Master has done."
"Definitely."
Looking at Xiao Huohuo who clenched his fists, Chu Feng secretly smiled.
This kid must be thinking again.
He sighed and thought to himself:
title_en: Chapter 25: Practicing one and a half levels of qi, shaking the world and almost destroying the city. Chapter 26: Practicing the Great Wilderness Heaven Prisoner's Finger. I am Master's disciple.
